title: Chapter 2 — Subfloor 1
description: Chapter 2 is in, and everything got a new coat of paint. The lift fight, the Playerr, the hoist escape and the smelter are all playable, and there is a DODGE roll to go with them. Chapter 1 was rebuilt with the same art.
changelog: Chapter 2 — Subfloor 1: sixteen rooms, two hunts and a new monster
New DODGE roll — tuck and go, with invulnerability frames
Lift fight: repair three systems while it swings at you
The Playerr: red, violet and blue, and it takes doors off their hinges
Hoist escape, battery cubes, the charger cell and the smelter finale
Rebuilt art: plated metal, bolts, rust, weld seams, tread floors
Cables now visibly pay out and sag as you haul them
New Chapter 1 ending — it lands on the car and caves the roof in
In-game updater, and every build now installs over the last one
More settings: brightness, screen shake, effects, hints, left-handed
notes: Installs over any earlier build and keeps every world. Every release is signed with one key so updates never need an uninstall. This manifest and the APK live in the public facility-core-releases repository; the game's source and its signing key stay private.
